notes.title: Patch 2.11
notes.content:
Patch 2.11 includes a series of small playability and accessibility updates, which help pave the way for our next round of feature updates!

Today's changes include:

 Fixed some issues with unlocking achievements.
 Fixed an issue where the wizards 'beam' attack would occasionally fire in the wrong direction.
 Changed font visibility and size for better readability.
 Minor accessibility changes throughout the menus.
 Minor accessibility changes to aid in Steam remote play together.


Additionally, we have seen that occasionally when using the Steam remote play features, connected controllers will not be recognized until they are unplugged and plugged back in. This is currently under investigation.

notes.title: Patch 2.09
notes.content:
We thank you all for the massive support we have received during the launch of Gladii, and we want you to know that we are hard at work on your feedback! More features and patches will be coming shortly. For now, we have addressed some of the most urgent issues.

Summary of changes:

 Fixed an issue where the pause menu would sometimes fail to activate when using the keyboard only.
 Fixed an issue with gold potions giving the wrong amount of healing to revived players.
